explanation: The requested W=1.45 GeV is below the eta production threshold (1.4861 GeV) and outside the lookup-table grid [1.4856, 6.0], so the kinematics are unphysical. W was corrected to 1.4961 GeV (the first table node above threshold), which is above the Delta(1232) resonance as intended. The corrected point passes preflight but carries a WARN that it is within 10 MeV of threshold, where the Fortran integrator is known to hang or return silent N/A. A smoke test with a short timeout is recommended before committing a full grid. Beam energy defaulted to 6.53 GeV (CLAS12 RG-K, the validated eta campaign).
